name: baselineguard-default-ruleset
description: A versioned, offline snapshot of Web platform feature availability. Status values follow the Baseline model: widely / newly / limited / deprecated. baseline_year is the year a feature became broadly available across the four major engines (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari) and is used for policy cropping, not as an authoritative compatibility claim.

rules.name: CSS Flexbox
rules.suggestion: Use flexbox freely; it is part of the long-stable Baseline.

rules.name: CSS Grid Layout
rules.suggestion: Use CSS Grid freely; it is part of the long-stable Baseline.

rules.name: CSS Custom Properties
rules.suggestion: CSS variables are safe to use; provide fallbacks via var(--x, fallback).

rules.name: CSS clamp()
rules.suggestion: Safe for fluid typography; keep a min/max fallback for very old engines.

rules.name: CSS :is() / :where()
rules.suggestion: Safe to use; remember :where() has zero specificity.

rules.name: CSS Logical Properties
rules.suggestion: Prefer logical properties for i18n-friendly layouts.

rules.name: CSS aspect-ratio
rules.suggestion: Safe to use; keep a padding-top fallback only for legacy engine support.

rules.name: Fetch API
rules.suggestion: Prefer fetch() over legacy XHR; add an AbortController for cancellation.

rules.name: async / await
rules.suggestion: Safe to use with a modern build target.

rules.name: Optional Chaining (?.)
rules.suggestion: Safe with ES2020+ targets; transpile when targeting legacy browsers.

rules.name: Nullish Coalescing (??)
rules.suggestion: Prefer ?? over || when only null/undefined should fall through.

rules.name: IntersectionObserver
rules.suggestion: Safe to use; feature-detect before constructing on very old engines.

rules.name: AbortController / AbortSignal
rules.suggestion: Safe to use for cancellable fetch and event listeners.

rules.name: Custom Elements / Web Components
rules.suggestion: Safe to use; remember custom element names must contain a hyphen.

rules.name: CSS Container Queries
rules.suggestion: Provide a media-query fallback, or declare --allow-newly explicitly with a documented degradation path.

rules.name: CSS :has()
rules.suggestion: Guard with @supports selector(:has(*)) or keep a JS fallback.

rules.name: Native CSS Nesting
rules.suggestion: Prefer a preprocessor build step, or require an explicit relaxation of the baseline policy.

rules.name: CSS Subgrid
rules.suggestion: Provide a nested-grid fallback for browsers without subgrid support.

rules.name: CSS color-mix()
rules.suggestion: Precompute the color in the design token layer for full compatibility.

rules.name: CSS Cascade Layers (@layer)
rules.suggestion: Keep a non-layered fallback ordering if older engines must be served.

rules.name: structuredClone()
rules.suggestion: Provide a JSON-based or manual clone fallback, or relax the baseline policy.

rules.name: Array.prototype.at()
rules.suggestion: Use arr[arr.length - 1] for full compatibility, or relax the baseline policy.

rules.name: Import Maps
rules.suggestion: Ship a bundler-based fallback for engines without import-map support.

rules.name: loading="lazy"
rules.suggestion: Harmless progressive enhancement: unsupported engines simply load eagerly.

rules.name: CSS View Transitions
rules.suggestion: Not available in all major engines. Always wrap with @supports and a no-animation fallback.

rules.name: CSS Scroll-driven Animations
rules.suggestion: Not available in all major engines; use IntersectionObserver as a fallback.

rules.name: CSS Anchor Positioning
rules.suggestion: Experimental in several engines; keep a JS positioning fallback.

rules.name: text-wrap: balance
rules.suggestion: Cosmetic enhancement only; safe to keep as progressive enhancement with --allow-limited.

rules.name: document.startViewTransition()
rules.suggestion: Feature-detect: if (!document.startViewTransition) { /* fallback */ }

rules.name: WebGPU
rules.suggestion: Not available in all major engines; provide a WebGL fallback path.

rules.name: Navigation API
rules.suggestion: Use the History API as a fallback until support is universal.

rules.name: <marquee>
rules.suggestion: Replace with CSS animations (transform / @keyframes).

rules.name: <center>
rules.suggestion: Replace with text-align: center or margin-inline: auto.

rules.name: <font>
rules.suggestion: Move all presentation into CSS (font-family, font-size, color).

rules.name: <big>
rules.suggestion: Replace with font-size: larger or a semantic heading element.

rules.name: <frameset> / <frame>
rules.suggestion: Replace with CSS layout and <iframe> only where embedding is truly required.

rules.name: <applet>
rules.suggestion: Remove; use <object> or a modern web component instead.

rules.name: <acronym>
rules.suggestion: Replace with <abbr title="...">.

rules.name: document.write()
rules.suggestion: Use DOM APIs (createElement / append) instead; document.write blocks parsing.

rules.name: window.showModalDialog()
rules.suggestion: Removed from modern engines; use <dialog> or a custom modal.

rules.name: event.returnValue
rules.suggestion: Use event.preventDefault() and event.defaultPrevented instead.
